tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rin chen tsha sbyor gyi zin bris gcong nad bde ster bzhugs so//

rigs rus snying rje lhag bsam rmad byung thugs bskyed chu gter las// brtson pa chen po 'bar ba'i drod bskyed gnas lnga'i rlabs chen po// chos nyid mkha' la sku gsung thugs kyi chu 'dzin ci yang 'khrigs// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi char rgyun snod ldan 'byor pa rgyas| |rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa'i yul du rta dbyangs bod yul 'dir// smon lam dbang gis khu li ri thang g.yu thog mgon zhes grags| |slar yang rnam 'dren gnas lnga'i paṇa chen dharma swa mi zhes// dag pa rab 'byams gang na bzhugs kyang sgo gsum gus pas mchod// sngon bsags bsod nams mthu las grub pa'i lus// dal 'byor shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed pa 'di// gcong nad sde bzhis stong log 'gro mthong nas// rgyu gnyis las kyi sdug bsngal bsgral phyir du// rin chen tsha sbyor zin bris 'di na bgyi// dang po 'bigs byed btsun mo gnyis// zho re lcags snod du bzhu la// dbyer med gyur tshe rdo steng byo// dngul 1 skam lta bur song ba de// gang du dgos par longs spyad de// gse 2 ra da 3 ngul 4 zangs lca 5 gas rnam pa bzhi// sbrang gshog dkar gong gis bcad la// snying po gnyen por ldan pa de// zhi ka'i kong bu sol mes bsreg |rtags ldan chus g.yengs dor ba las// rin chen kā la'i mdog can 'grub// 'khor gyi sman rnams 'di lta ste// gu gul da 6 kar na 7 ga so ma 8 ra// tha 9 la rdo khro 10 gnyer sga 11 skya dang*// drod sman hri 12 la 'jo 13 nga tsi tra 14 ka /re skon 15 seng ldeng kha 16 ṇ+ḍa dang*// dbya 17 ི mong srub 18 ka lce tsha 19 ba// da li 20 sa 'gron tha 21 la bzang po dru 27 ga /sma 28 na chen a 29 ru 30 gla rtsi rnams// zhib btags lo brgyad chus sbyangs la// 'dam 'thag yun ring byas pa dang*// ril bu sran ma tsam du dril// lnga bdun dgu sogs rim pa bzhin// chu bskol gyis sam su ras dbul// de ltar sman sna sum cu po// tshad ldan sbyar ba'i phan yon ni// dmu chu 'or dang skya rbab dang*// mdze 'bras grum bu dkar nag khra// gag lhog gnyan rigs grang srin dang*// za khu 'theng skrangs zha 'khums las// gyur pa'i nad rigs thams cad dang*// khyad par grang ba'i nad kun la// slebs pas chog pa rang bzo min// tsha shas can la gtong na yang*// bsil ba'i khri'ur bsten shes na// ltar snang tsha ba'i mgo 'phur bshu// gnyen po nad thog 'bab par 'gyur// de bas sbyor ba 'di mchog yin// de ltar tsha sbyor ril bu 'di// g.yu thog mgon dang dharma'i mtshan// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dag las 'ongs/
/shākya'i dge slong ming dharma/ /kīrtis sbyar 'dis 'gro drug po/ /dug lnga'i nad zhi sangs rgyas gang*// sman bla'i go 'phang myur thob shog / zur mkhar ba'i khyad chos so// //maṅga laṃ//
